/** * Returns a set view of the mappings contained in this map. Each element * in the returned set is a {@code Map.Entry}. The set is backed by the * map, so changes to the map are reflected in the set, and vice-versa. * If the map is modified while an iteration over the set is in progress, * the results of the iteration are undefined. The set supports element * removal, which removes the corresponding mapping from the map, via the * {@code Iterator.remove}, {@code Set.remove}, {@code removeAll}, * {@code retainAll} and {@code clear} operations. It does not support * the {@code add} or {@code addAll} operations. *

* This implementation returns a {@code CompositeSet} which * composites the entry sets from all of the composited maps. * * @see CompositeSet * @return a set view of the mappings contained in this map. */
